verdict_reason: The pickUp hand-over to the address-book pointer is correct apart from req-611, which lands in requirements with no fingerprint, so drift on it would never be reported.

todos.issue: The address-book splitOff pointer moves req-611, req-2186 and req-2199 from pickUp into requirements, but records a fingerprint only for req-2186 and req-2199 (lines 2002-2003). tim/src/distil/coverage.js fingerprintChanged (473-481) returns false when the pointer keeps no fingerprint, so a later re-distil that changes req-611's text will never list it as changed for the address-book branch: its drift goes unreported. coverage.js:494-496 says the pointer takes fingerprintsNow for every picked-up requirement once the branch has its rows.
todos.fix: Must: every requirement the pointer took from pickUp (req-611, req-2186, req-2199) has its current fingerprint in the pointer's fingerprints, so a later change to any of them is reported. One way: add "req-611" with requirementFingerprintOf(req-611) from the re-distil report's fingerprintsNow (or recompute it from distil/requirements.json) beside req-2186 and req-2199.
